criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.
Given the data files, when any tab renders, then its content comes from .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json read at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given .colaberry/manifest.json, when any tab is shown, then it displays how old the data is and warns when that age exceeds a week.
Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.
Given an Excel file, when I upload it, then the system cleans the data.
Given a malformed Excel file, when I upload it, then the system reports an error.
Trust: The system logs the data cleaning process.

tests_added: POST /api/upload rejects an unsupported file format
POST /api/upload rejects a request with no file attached
stories.notes: REQ-001 (upload) implemented: POST /api/upload accepts .csv/.xlsx/.xls, rejects other formats and missing files with a typed 400, caps file size, logs every attempt. REQ-002 (cleaning) not started -- paused here by explicit request before writing the parsing/cleaning service. All 3 acceptance criteria require cleaning, so none pass yet; this is an honest in-progress state, not a completed story.
stories.verification: tsc --noEmit clean; jest 5/5 passing; manual end-to-end curl check against the built server for valid .csv, unsupported .txt, and no-file-attached cases. No cleaning-service verification yet -- not built.

criteria.text: Given cleaned data, when KPIs are calculated, then they are displayed correctly.
Given incomplete data, when KPIs are calculated, then the system requests clarification.
Trust: The system logs KPI calculations and evidence levels.
Given calculated KPIs, when I access the dashboard, then they are displayed clearly.
Given no KPIs, when I access the dashboard, then it shows a message indicating no data.
Trust: The system logs dashboard access and interactions.
Given significant KPI changes, when they occur, then the system sends an alert via email.
Given no significant changes, when I check alerts, then no new alerts are sent.
Trust: The system logs all alerts sent and their contents.
Given data is available in Google Sheets and QuickBooks, when synchronization is initiated, then the data should be accurately reflected in the system.
Given a failure in data synchronization, when the system retries, then the synchronization should complete successfully without data loss.
Trust: Every synchronization attempt must be logged with a timestamp and status.
Given a subscription plan, when I select it, then my account is updated accordingly.
Given an expired plan, when I try to upload data, then the system prompts for renewal.
Trust: The system logs all subscription changes and usage.
Given uncertain KPI calculations, when they occur, then the system requests clarification.
Given a KPI with low confidence, when displayed, then it shows the evidence level.
Trust: The system logs all uncertainty handling and evidence levels.
Given business actions, when a report is generated, then it includes all relevant decisions.
Given no actions, when a report is generated, then it indicates no actions taken.
Trust: The system logs all report generation activities.
Given an insight, when I provide feedback, then the system records it.
Given no feedback, when I check insights, then the system prompts for feedback.
Trust: The system logs all feedback received and its impact.
Given the dashboard, when accessed, then it is simple and intuitive.
Given a complex interface, when simplified, then user satisfaction increases.
Trust: The system logs user interactions and feedback on interface changes.
Given data is processed, when a processing error occurs, then the system should retry the operation without duplicating data.
Given data processing is complete, when an audit is conducted, then all processing steps should be logged with timestamps.
Trust: Every data processing step must be logged with a unique identifier and status.
Given a significant change in KPI, when the system detects the change, then it should verify the change before sending an alert.
Given a false positive KPI change, when verification fails, then no alert should be sent.
Trust: Every KPI change verification must be logged with the result and timestamp.
Given data is available, when report generation is initiated, then a detailed report should be produced with all relevant metrics.
Given incomplete data, when report generation is attempted, then the system should notify the user of missing data.
Trust: Every report generation must be logged with the parameters used and timestamp.
Given an insight is recorded, when a change is made, then the system should allow the user to undo the change.
Given a user attempts to undo a change, when the change is reversible, then the system should restore the previous state.
Trust: Every insight change and undo action must be logged with a timestamp.
